title: Drake drops THREE albums in one night
blurb: Iceman, Habibti & Maid of Honour — 43 songs total. First artist EVER to hold the top 3 spots on the Billboard 200 at once.

title: "Janice STFU" debuts at #1, breaks a Michael Jackson record

title: Rick Ross calls Iceman "horrendous," claps back at Drake's singing

title: Kendrick STILL hasn't responded to Drake's 3 albums

title: T.I. vs 50 Cent is heating up after the Verzuz snub
blurb: Two veterans, zero chill. The shots are flying.

title: Uncle Murda thinks Jay-Z is about to respond to Drake
blurb: Iceman took shots at Hov — and Murda says a reply is coming.

title: Kendrick, Cardi B & Monaleo clean up at the 2026 AMAs
blurb: Rap took over the American Music Awards stage in a big way.

title: Lil Uzi Vert is teasing a new album

title: The "67" (Six Seven) brainrot meme is EVERYWHERE

title: OCTANE is the highest-selling rap album of 2026
